notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, and if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Life Finds A Way trigger, if applicable, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
When the Egg enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
